context: Two friends chat about life in different Tokyo neighborhoods
purpose: Teach: 寮/都内/丁目/独身/パーク/接近/銀座/県内

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイ、久しぶり。今も都内に住んでるの？
lines.en: Mei, long time no see. Are you still living in Tokyo?
lines.style: Warm casual greeting between close female friends reconnecting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、会社の独身寮にね。銀座まで電車で二十分くらい。
lines.en: Yeah, in the company's singles dorm. About twenty minutes by train to Ginza.
lines.style: Soft dreamy tone with a hint of pride about location.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいなあ、銀座通り近いんだ。私は三丁目の小さなアパートだよ。
lines.en: Nice, Ginza Street is close then. I'm in a tiny apartment in the third block.
lines.style: Cheerful barista voice, lightly envious but content.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でも寮って門限厳しくてさ、終電が接近するたびに走ってるの…
lines.en: But the dorm's curfew is strict, so I'm running every time the last train approaches…
lines.style: Sheepish giggly confession with playful self-deprecation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あはは、近所のテーマパークでデートして早めに帰ればいいじゃん。
lines.en: Haha, just go on dates at the nearby theme park and head home early.
lines.style: Teasing laughter, playful suggestion from a good friend.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 実は彼、来月から県内の別の支店に転勤するかもなんだ…
lines.en: Actually, he might transfer to another branch within the prefecture next month…
lines.style: Voice trailing off, tender melancholy of looming separation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えー、寂しくなるね…でも近いし、週末は通えるよ、きっと大丈夫。
lines.en: Aw, that'll be lonely… but it's close, you can visit on weekends, you'll be fine.
lines.style: Gentle reassuring tone, empathetic warmth from a caring friend.
